risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong fiscal 2016 performance with substantial quantified improvements in revenue, profitability, leverage, and cash generation. Key risks include cyclical and uneven nonresidential construction demand, steel-price volatility and supply constraints, pass-through limitations, and reliance on forward-looking industry indicators. Overall tone is confident but includes standard forward-looking caveats and material commodity and macroeconomic exposures.
